label: Земля
description: A 10-sentence usage card for земля (earth; land).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Земля' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'вращается'. 'Вокруг солнца' is the genitive complement showing the orbit.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Землю' is the accusative direct object of 'любят'. 'Свою' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'фермеры' is the plural subject.

missions.phrase: У этой земли очень богатая история.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Земли' is the genitive form after 'у', showing whose history it is. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 'Земле' is the dative form, the thing that needs rain. 'Сухой' agrees in the feminine dative, and 'дождь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'Землёй' is the instrumental form after 'над', expressing position above. 'Самолёт' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В земле' uses the prepositional form 'земле' after 'в' to express location. 'Семена' is the neuter plural subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На земле' uses the prepositional form 'земле' after 'на' to mean on the ground. 'Дети' is the plural subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Земля' is nominative as the subject. 'Эта' points at a specific plot, and 'плодородная' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Земли' is the nominative plural subject of 'принадлежат'. 'Эти' agrees as the plural demonstrative, and 'государству' is the dative.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Землю' is the accusative form after 'на', marking the destination of falling. 'Лист' is the nominative subject.
